relations.text: Walmart+の燃料割引などで協業
relations.text_en: Collaborates on fuel discount programs such as Walmart+

source.label: Murphy USA 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We continue to collaborate with Walmart on fuel discount programs, mainly Walmart+, which we believe enhances the customer value proposition as well as the competitive position of both Murphy USA and Walmart.

relations.text_en: Spun off from Murphy Oil in 2013

source.label: Murphy USA 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Grow organically We intend for our evolving NTI real estate strategy to be a key driver of our organic growth over the next several years, which is demonstrated by the over 500 stores that have been added to Murphy USA since our 2013 spin-off from Murphy Oil Corporation.
